```{ojs}
//| output: false
compareRegionRows = db && compareCountry !== "All countries"
  ? db.query(`
      SELECT region,
             brand,
             strftime(capture_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d,
             n_stations,
             n_stations_usd,
             median_local_per_litre,
             p25_local_per_litre,
             p75_local_per_litre,
             median_usd_per_litre,
             p25_usd_per_litre,
             p75_usd_per_litre
      FROM summary_daily
      WHERE level = 'region' AND country = ${sqlText(compareCountry)}
        AND grade = ${sqlText(grade)}${chainClause}
      ORDER BY region, brand, capture_date
    `)
  : []

// Newest day per key, flagging any that lag behind the global newest.
compareRegionLatest = {
  const {newestFor, newest} = newestByKey(
    compareRegionRows,
    (row) => `${row.region} :: ${row.brand}`
  );
  const rows = [...newestFor.values()]
    .map((row) => Object.assign({}, row, {sold: true, stale: row.d < newest}))
    .sort((a, b) => (b.median_usd_per_litre ?? 0) - (a.median_usd_per_litre ?? 0));
  return {rows, newest};
}
```

## Latest day
::: {.cgp-panel .cgp-chart-card}

```{ojs}
compareView = {
  if (!db) return html`<div class="cgp-notice">Loading the price database…</div>`;

  // One mark set, four scopes. `x` carries a price where a single currency is
  // on screen and a percent change where it is not; everything else is the same
  // chart, so the page reads the same way whichever question is being asked.
  function dotPlot(rows, {axisLabel, axisShort, colorOf, zeroRule, tipTitle, marginLeft}) {
    // A phone has 337px for the whole chart. There a row's label puts each of
    // its parts -- place, chain, day or today's median -- on a line of its own,
    // because "United Kingdom · 2026-09-18" in one line needed half the width
    // and still lost its first letter. An axis label with a short form takes it,
    // since the long one ran off the chart's left edge.
    const narrow = chartWidth < 500;
    if (narrow) {
      rows = rows.map((row) => Object.assign({}, row, {label: row.label.split(" · ").join("\n")}));
    }
    const lines = Math.max(1, ...rows.map((row) => row.label.split("\n").length));
    const pitch = Math.max(rows.length > 16 ? 22 : 34, 11 * lines + 6);
    const radius = rows.length > 16 ? 4 : 6;
    const countText = (row) => `${row.n} station${row.n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
    const marks = [];
    if (zeroRule) marks.push(Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: palette.grid}));
    marks.push(
      Plot.ruleY(rows, {
        y: "label",
        x1: "p25",
        x2: "p75",
        stroke: palette.muted,
        strokeOpacity: 0.32,
        strokeWidth: rows.length > 16 ? 7 : 10
      }),
      Plot.text(rows, {
        y: "label",
        frameAnchor: "right",
        textAnchor: "start",
        dx: 8,
        fontSize: 11,
        fill: palette.muted,
        text: countText
      }),
      Plot.dot(rows, {
        y: "label",
        x: "value",
        r: radius,
        fill: colorOf,
        stroke: palette.stroke,
        strokeWidth: 1
      }),
      Plot.text(rows, {
        y: "label",
        x: "value",
        text: (row) => row.valueText,
        dy: -14,
        fill: palette.text
      }),
      // Last, so it paints over the value labels rather than under them.
      Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointer({y: "label", x: "value", ...tipStyle(), title: tipTitle}))
    );
    // The callers ask for up to 260px of label gutter, which is right on a wide
    // screen and impossible on a phone: at 390px chartWidth is 337, so a 260/110
    // pair leaves an x range of [260, 227] -- negative. Every dot then lands on
    // the same cx and the chart asserts that every country moved identically,
    // while the text labels print the real, differing values. Keep at least
    // 140px of plot area, whatever was asked for.
    //
    // A chain's name makes a label longer than any the callers planned for
    // ("United States · Sam's Club · 2026-09-15" lost its first letter), so the
    // gutter grows to the longest line of a label, at about 5.2px a character
    // of Plot's 10px type. Every label without one already fits what was asked.
    //
    // The station counts sit in the right-hand gutter, which on a phone was a
    // fixed 56px: "596 stations" drew as "596 stati". There it is sized to the
    // longest count, at about 5.6px a character of their 11px type.
    const longestCount = Math.max(0, ...rows.map((row) => countText(row).length));
    const marginRightUsed = narrow ? Math.ceil(12 + 5.6 * longestCount) : 110;
    const longest = Math.max(
      0,
      ...rows.flatMap((row) => row.label.split("\n").map((line) => line.length))
    );
    const marginLeftUsed = Math.min(
      Math.max(marginLeft, Math.ceil(16 + 5.2 * longest)),
      Math.max(80, chartWidth - marginRightUsed - 140)
    );
    return Plot.plot({
      width: chartWidth,
      ariaLabel: `${axisLabel} by country`,
      height: 52 + rows.length * pitch,
      marginLeft: marginLeftUsed,
      marginRight: marginRightUsed,
      style: {background: "transparent", color: palette.text},
      x: {label: narrow && axisShort ? axisShort : axisLabel, grid: true, nice: true},
      y: {domain: rows.map((row) => row.label), label: null},
      marks
    });
  }

  const priceKey = (what) =>
    spreadKeyEl(
      "median station",
      "middle half of stations: p25 to p75",
      `Half of a ${what}'s stations price inside the bar — a quarter below its left end, ` +
        "a quarter above its right end."
    );

  const wrap = (key, figure, note) =>
    html`<div>${key}${figure}${note ? html`<div class="cgp-notice">${note}</div>` : ""}</div>`;

  // ---- one country, by region -------------------------------------------
  if (compareCountry !== "All countries") {
    const regionRows = compareRegionLatest.rows;
    if (!regionRows.length) {
      return html`<div class="cgp-notice">${COUNTRY_NAMES[compareCountry]} publishes no region,
        so there is no breakdown to show. Its national figure is on the All countries view.</div>`;
    }
    // Inside one country there is one currency, so local prices need no
    // transform: Ontario and Quebec both price in CAD.
    const unit = currency === "USD" ? "USD" : currencyOf.get(compareCountry) || "local";
    const pick = (row, which) =>
      perVolume(currency === "USD" ? row[`${which}_usd_per_litre`] : row[`${which}_local_per_litre`], volume);
    // The chain is named by the rule the country rows use, so a state both
    // chains serve reads as two rows and a single-chain country as before.
    const nameOf = (row) => placeLabel(row.region, compareCountry, row.brand, compareLatest.chains);
    const rows = regionRows
      .map((row) => ({
        label: `${nameOf(row)}${row.stale ? " (stale)" : ""}`,
        name: nameOf(row),
        value: pick(row, "median"),
        p25: pick(row, "p25"),
        p75: pick(row, "p75"),
        n: row.n_stations,
        nUsd: row.n_stations_usd,
        region: row.region,
        d: row.d
      }))
      .filter((row) => row.value != null)
      .map((row) => Object.assign(row, {valueText: fmtNumber(row.value, priceDigits)}));
    if (!rows.length) {
      return html`<div class="cgp-notice">No ${unit} values for ${GRADE_LABELS[grade]} in
        ${COUNTRY_NAMES[compareCountry]}.</div>`;
    }
    return wrap(
      priceKey("region"),
      dotPlot(rows, {
        axisLabel: `${GRADE_LABELS[grade]}, ${unit} ${volumeLabel} — ${COUNTRY_NAMES[compareCountry]} by region`,
        colorOf: () => COUNTRY_COLORS[compareCountry],
        zeroRule: false,
        marginLeft: 200,
        tipTitle: (row) =>
          `${row.name} · ${row.d}\n` +
          `median ${fmtNumber(row.value, priceDigits)} ${unit}${volumeShort}\n` +
          `p25 ${fmtNumber(row.p25, priceDigits)} · p75 ${fmtNumber(row.p75, priceDigits)}\n` +
          `${row.n} station${row.n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
      }),
      `Regions of ${COUNTRY_NAMES[compareCountry]} on its own newest day for each. One country ` +
        `prices in one currency, so these are real prices.`
    );
  }

  // ---- all countries, local currency: change, not price ------------------
  if (currency === "Local") {
    // Keyed on the chain as well as the country, so each row is divided by its
    // own chain's price and never by the other chain's.
    const series = new Map();
    for (const row of compareRows) {
      const value = perVolume(row.median_local_per_litre, volume);
      if (value == null) continue;
      const key = seriesOf(row);
      if (!series.has(key)) series.set(key, []);
      series.get(key).push({day: toDay(row.d), value, row});
    }
    const baseDay = commonBaseDay([...series.values()]);
    const rows = [];
    for (const item of compareLatest.rows.filter((row) => row.sold)) {
      const history = series.get(seriesOf(item));
      const anchor = history ? anchorRow(history, baseDay) : null;
      const median = perVolume(item.median_local_per_litre, volume);
      if (!anchor || median == null) continue;
      const unit = currencyOf.get(item.country) || "local";
      rows.push({
        label: `${item.label} · ${fmtNumber(median, priceDigits)} ${unit}${volumeShort}${item.stale ? " (stale)" : ""}`,
        name: item.label,
        country: item.country,
        value: pctFrom(median, anchor.value),
        p25: pctFrom(perVolume(item.p25_local_per_litre, volume), anchor.value),
        p75: pctFrom(perVolume(item.p75_local_per_litre, volume), anchor.value),
        n: item.n_stations,
        median,
        unit,
        d: item.d,
        anchorDay: dayText(anchor.day)
      });
    }
    const priced = rows.filter((row) => row.value != null)
      .map((row) => Object.assign(row, {valueText: fmtPct(row.value)}));
    if (!priced.length || !baseDay) {
      return html`<div class="cgp-notice">Not enough history yet for
        ${GRADE_LABELS[grade]}.</div>`;
    }
    const baseText = dayText(baseDay);
    return wrap(
      spreadKeyEl(
        `median, change since ${baseText}`,
        "middle half of stations today, against the same starting point",
        `Each country is divided by its own price on ${baseText}, in its own currency — nothing ` +
          "is converted. Its median today is printed with its name."
      ),
      dotPlot(priced, {
        axisLabel: `Change in median ${GRADE_LABELS[grade]} since ${baseText}, each country in its own currency (%)`,
        axisShort: `Change in median since ${baseText} (%)`,
        colorOf: (row) => COUNTRY_COLORS[row.country],
        zeroRule: true,
        marginLeft: 260,
        tipTitle: (row) =>
          `${row.name} · ${row.d}\n` +
          `${fmtPct(row.value)} since ${row.anchorDay}\n` +
          `${fmtNumber(row.median, priceDigits)} ${row.unit}${volumeShort} today\n` +
          `${row.n} station${row.n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
      })
    );
  }

  // ---- all countries, USD: real prices on one axis -----------------------
  const data = compareLatest.rows
    .filter((row) => row.sold)
    .map((row) => ({
      label: `${row.label} · ${row.d}${row.stale ? " (stale)" : ""}`,
      name: row.label,
      country: row.country,
      value: perVolume(row.median_usd_per_litre, volume),
      p25: perVolume(row.p25_usd_per_litre, volume),
      p75: perVolume(row.p75_usd_per_litre, volume),
      // n_stations counts stations; n_stations_usd counts the ones that had an
      // exchange rate. The annotation said "stations" and showed the latter.
      n: row.n_stations,
      nUsd: row.n_stations_usd,
      d: row.d
    }))
    .filter((row) => row.value != null)
    .map((row) => Object.assign(row, {valueText: fmtNumber(row.value, priceDigits)}));
  if (!data.length) {
    return html`<div class="cgp-notice">No USD values for ${GRADE_LABELS[grade]}.</div>`;
  }
  return wrap(
    priceKey("country"),
    dotPlot(data, {
      axisLabel: `${GRADE_LABELS[grade]}, USD ${volumeLabel}`,
      colorOf: (row) => COUNTRY_COLORS[row.country],
      zeroRule: false,
      marginLeft: 200,
      tipTitle: (row) =>
        `${row.name} · ${row.d}\n` +
        `median ${fmtNumber(row.value, priceDigits)} USD ${volumeLabel}\n` +
        `p25 ${fmtNumber(row.p25, priceDigits)} · p75 ${fmtNumber(row.p75, priceDigits)}\n` +
        `${row.n} station${row.n === 1 ? "" : "s"}` +
        (row.nUsd != null && row.nUsd !== row.n ? `, ${row.nUsd} with a USD price` : "")
    })
  );
}
```

## Notes
::: {.cgp-panel .cgp-notes-card}

```{ojs}
compareNotes = {
  const notSold = compareLatest.rows
    .filter((row) => !row.sold)
    .map((row) => COUNTRY_NAMES[row.country]);
  return html`<div class="cgp-notice">
    ${notSold.length ? html`<div>Not sold: ${notSold.join(", ")}.</div>` : ""}
    <div>Grades differ by country — see the <a href="about.html">grade table</a>.</div>
  </div>`;
}
```
